$comment: Root ADR-0495. The 주소DB (구 매칭데이터, rtlDtaDtlSn 8) of 주소기반산업지원서비스, collected with no login and no key through the provider's own public download screen API: a list answer names the month's full file and every day's change file, and a download answer is the zip. Measured 2026-11-11 (W65 msg_91b0674446b7, W66): the list is HTTP 200 JSON, the 202610 full is 181,440,694 bytes (HTTP 200, 49 s), the 20261029 day file 18,583 bytes; a list for month M names the days of M and M-1. The collector (`collect-juso-address-db` in services/foundation-outbox-publisher) and the Silver load (infra/lakehouse/spark/jobs/juso_address_db.py) read this file; nothing else restates these values.
user_agent: foundation-platform-juso-address-db-collector/1 (+root ADR-0495; one full once, then each day's change file)

list.$comment: POST JSON {rtlDtaDtlSn, year, month, expand}. results.allMonthFileList holds the year's twelve months, results.dayFileList the days of the asked month and the month before; isExist Y names a file that is there.

download.$comment: GET with these query parameters, each filled from the list row: regYmd the period's year, reqType the file kind's req_type, ctprvnCd the kind's ctprvn_cd, stdde the period (crtrYm or crtrYmd), fileName the row's fileNm, realFileName its tmprFileNm, intFileNo and intNum empty. The answer is the zip (content-type says application/json; the bytes start with PK).

files.$comment: Keyed by the catalog's dataset slug (Bronze source jusogokr__<slug>). monthly_full is landed once, as the base; daily_change every day from the base's month on (one month of overlap: a change replayed onto a base that already holds it ends in the same row, root ADR-0494 does the same).

per_run_cap.$comment: A run lands the base when it has none, then the day files from its cursor to yesterday (KST), oldest first, up to max_day_files_per_run files and max_bytes_per_run bytes over the run, whichever comes first; the cursor stops where the run stopped. The base is 181 MB and a day file 1 KB to 100 KB (the 61 listed on 2026-11-11 hold 16 to 1,883 changed addresses each), so the first run is the base and about 41 days, and every run after one day.

members.$comment: The text members inside the zips, CP949, '|'-separated, no header line (the provider's guide 「주소DB 활용방법」 in the full zip). The full has 주소_<시도>.txt, 지번_<시도>.txt, 부가정보_<시도>.txt and 개선_도로명코드_전체분.txt; a day file AlterD.JUSUMT.<YYYYMMDD>.MATCHING_JUSO/JIBUN/ADDINFO/ROAD.TXT with the same columns plus a change reason (변경사유코드: 31 신규, 34 변경, 63 폐지). The Silver load reads only the address and jibun members and the road code table.
